title: Expose PVE host pc01 to the tailnet (subnet route for 192.168.68.0/24 or host join)
description: Prereq for the Gatus monitoring task: digitalocean-gatus-01 cannot reach 192.168.68.112:8006 — no subnet router advertises 192.168.68.0/24 to the tailnet (verified 2026-10-14; existing routers cover 10.x/172.20.x only). Options: (a) subnet router on the home LAN advertising 192.168.68.0/24 (URL stays 192.168.68.112:8006), or (b) join the PVE host to the tailnet (URL becomes host tailnet IP). The Gatus endpoint in nixos/modules/gatus/config.yaml is committed commented-out pending this task.
